outcome: Differentiation of placenta previa patients with and without PAS disorders
Prediction of the degree of placental invasiveness in FIGO PAS grades
cohort: 40 multiparous pregnant women with complete placenta previa between 34 and 38 weeks of gestation (25 with PAS and 15 without PAS)
finding: Low serum levels and high placental bed tissue expression of IGF-1, or high serum levels and high placental bed tissue expression of PLGF, may differentiate placenta previa patients with FIGO PAS grade I and II from those without PAS disorders, but these markers cannot significantly predict the degree of placental invasiveness in FIGO PAS grades II and III.
